name: Colombo National Museum
scope: The Colombo National Museum’s extant main building, including the surviving Italianate front and the attached museum ranges.
era: Extant main building after restoration, preserving the historic 1877 frontage

categories: Images created or edited with IrfanView
references.publication: Popular Science Monthly, vol. 71, December 1907, page 493, figure 3

originalReview.notes: Shows the original Italianate south frontage, two rows of curved openings, projected central and lateral bays, pilasters, triangular pediments and parapet. The real wall contact follows the extant map.

review.method: Exact Qualla photograph in a verified expired periodical and current mapped museum outline
review.notes: Started from the exact Qualla image. The native original matches the expired New York periodical illustration, with its printed page and museum caption corroborated by the scanned issue and Wikisource. Other public-domain Qualla imagery depicts a collection object and attribution-conditioned exterior images were excluded.
